items.zh: 你能帮我看一下这个表格吗？我总觉得哪里不对。
items.scene: 下午快下班，你看到同事对着报表发愁

answers.en: Can you take a look at this spreadsheet? Something feels off.
answers.note: take a look 是随口求助，Something feels off 表示说不上来哪里不对，适合熟人。

answers.en: Would you mind giving this spreadsheet a quick look? I can't put my finger on what's wrong.
answers.note: Would you mind 更客气，quick 暗示只占用一小会儿；put my finger on 指说出问题在哪。

answers.en: Could I borrow your eyes for a second? I think there's a mistake in this spreadsheet.
answers.note: borrow your eyes 是办公室俏皮说法，轻松熟络，只适合关系近的同事。

items.zh: 这个数据我不会弄，你能教教我吗？
items.scene: 你刚入职，第一次做月报卡在数据透视表

answers.en: I can't figure out this data. Can you show me how?
answers.note: figure out 指弄不明白，语气坦诚；show me how 是请对方演示，适合平级同事。

answers.en: I'm stuck on this data. Would you mind walking me through it?
answers.note: be stuck on 强调卡住；walk me through 指一步步带着做，礼貌且具体。

answers.en: Could you teach me how to handle this data when you have a minute?
answers.note: 加 when you have a minute 表示不催对方，适合对方正忙或关系一般时。

items.zh: 你现在忙吗？能不能帮我顶十分钟？
items.scene: 你要下楼取快递，请邻座同事盯一下

answers.en: Are you busy right now? Could you cover for me for ten minutes?
answers.note: cover for me 指临时替你盯着，先问忙不忙再开口，是办公室常见顺序。

answers.en: Got a sec? I need someone to hold the fort for ten minutes.
answers.note: hold the fort 指临时守着；Got a sec 很随意，只对关系好的同事说。

answers.en: Would you be able to keep an eye on things for about ten minutes? I have to run downstairs.
answers.note: 最礼貌完整，keep an eye on things 语气轻，适合不太熟的同事。

items.zh: 你的充电器借我用一下行吗？我手机快没电了。
items.scene: 开会前手机只剩百分之三的电，你问旁边同事

answers.en: Can I borrow your charger? My phone's about to die.
answers.note: 最直接的借法，about to die 指快关机，熟人之间常用。

answers.en: Could I use your charger for a bit? My phone's almost dead.
answers.note: Could I use 比 borrow 稍客气，for a bit 说明只用一会儿，不带走。

answers.en: Would you mind if I borrowed your charger? I'm at three percent.
answers.note: Would you mind if 最客气；报出具体电量，画面感强，适合不熟的人。

items.zh: 你带伞了吗？外面下大了，我得出趟门。
items.scene: 你下午要见客户，窗外突然下起大雨

answers.en: Did you bring an umbrella? It's really coming down out there.
answers.note: coming down 指雨下得很大，先问带没带，暗示想借但没直说。

answers.en: Do you have a spare umbrella I could borrow? It's pouring and I have to get to a client's office.
answers.note: spare 指多余的伞；pouring 是下暴雨的口语说法，说明借的原因。

answers.en: Any chance you have an umbrella I could borrow? I'm due at a client's office in twenty minutes.
answers.note: Any chance 开头带试探，due at 指约好要到，时间压力让请求更自然。

items.zh: 周六的班我能跟你换一下吗？我表妹结婚。
items.scene: 排班表刚出来，你和同事都值周六

answers.en: Can we swap shifts on Saturday? My cousin's getting married.
answers.note: swap shifts 是最常用的换班说法，直说原因，适合平级同事。

answers.en: Would you be able to cover my Saturday shift? I can take one of yours next week.
answers.note: cover my shift 指替班；主动提出还班，让对方更容易答应。

answers.en: Any way you could switch shifts with me Saturday? It's my cousin's wedding.
answers.note: Any way you could 带商量口吻，不像硬要求，适合不太熟时开口。

items.zh: 下周三你能不能帮我代个班？我孩子要开家长会。
items.scene: 你实在走不开，找关系不错的同事商量

answers.en: Could you cover my shift next Wednesday? I have a parent-teacher meeting.
answers.note: 直接说明时间，parent-teacher meeting 是美式说法，适合平级同事。

answers.en: I hate to ask, but could you cover for me next Wednesday? It's my kid's parent-teacher conference.
answers.note: I hate to ask 先示弱；conference 是美式常用说法，适合麻烦别人时。

answers.en: Is there any chance you could take my Wednesday shift? I'll owe you one.
answers.note: I'll owe you one 是口语承诺欠人情，语气轻松，适合关系好的同事。

items.zh: 你下周是不是想休周五？我跟你换。
items.scene: 同事在群里问谁能换班，你正好想休周一

answers.en: You want Friday off next week? I'll swap with you.
answers.note: 省掉 Do 的疑问句很口语，I'll swap 立刻表态，适合群里快速回复。

answers.en: Are you trying to get Friday off? I could take it if you take my Monday.
answers.note: 把交换条件一句说清，避免来回确认，适合直接在排班群说。

answers.en: I saw you want Friday off — I'd be happy to switch if you can cover Monday.
answers.note: I'd be happy to 显得主动，条件说在后面，适合稍正式的消息。

items.zh: 你能不能跟老板说一声，我下午晚点到？
items.scene: 你上午要去医院复查，怕老板找不到人

answers.en: Can you let the boss know I'll be in late this afternoon?
answers.note: let someone know 是最中性的转达说法，适合平级同事帮忙。

answers.en: Could you give him a heads-up that I'll be late this afternoon?
answers.note: give a heads-up 指提前打招呼，比 let him know 更口语、更像同事间。

answers.en: Would you mind telling him I'll be coming in late? I have a doctor's appointment.
answers.note: 最礼貌，补上原因显得可信，适合请不太熟的同事传话。

items.zh: 他要是问起我，你就说我在开会。
items.scene: 客户一直打电话，你想让前台帮你挡

answers.en: If he asks, just tell him I'm in a meeting.
answers.note: 最直接的挡话，just 让语气像随口交代，适合熟人之间。

answers.en: If he comes looking for me, tell him I'm tied up in a meeting.
answers.note: tied up 指脱不开身，比 in a meeting 更像真实现场。

answers.en: Should he ask, would you mind saying I'm in a meeting?
answers.note: Should he ask 是较正式的倒装，语气客气，适合对前台或上级说。

items.zh: 三点那个会你去吗？我不想一个人去。
items.scene: 你被临时拉进跨部门会，想找熟人一起

answers.en: Are you going to the three o'clock meeting? I don't want to walk in alone.
answers.note: walk in alone 有画面感，直接说不想一个人，适合关系好的同事。

answers.en: You going to the three o'clock? I'd rather not sit through it by myself.
answers.note: 省略 Are 很口语；sit through 指硬着头皮听完，带点抱怨。

answers.en: Will you be at the three o'clock meeting? I'd feel better having someone there.
answers.note: 更含蓄，用 I'd feel better 表达想有伴，适合不太熟的同事。

items.zh: 会议纪要我发你了，你看一眼有没有漏的。
items.scene: 刚开完项目会，你把纪要发给同事核对

answers.en: I sent you the meeting notes. Can you check if anything's missing?
answers.note: meeting notes 是美式常用说法，直接请对方查漏，适合平级。

answers.en: Just sent over the meeting notes — could you give them a once-over?
answers.note: once-over 指快速过一遍，比 check 更口语，破折号让语气更随意。

answers.en: I've shared the meeting minutes with you. Would you mind reviewing them for anything I missed?
answers.note: minutes 是会议纪要的正式词，整句适合邮件或对上级说。

items.zh: 这会还得开多久？我后面还有个客户。
items.scene: 会议拖了四十分钟，你给旁边同事发消息

answers.en: How much longer is this meeting? I have a client after this.
answers.note: 最直接的问法，说明后面有安排，适合私聊同事。

answers.en: Any idea when this is wrapping up? I've got a client waiting.
answers.note: wrap up 指结束；got a client waiting 更有紧迫感，适合发消息。

answers.en: Do you know how much longer this will run? I have a client meeting right after.
answers.note: 最完整礼貌，run 指会议持续，适合问不太熟的同事。

items.zh: 这封邮件我要不要抄送我们组长？
items.scene: 你要回客户一封报价邮件，拿不准抄送范围

answers.en: Should I cc our team lead on this email?
answers.note: cc 是抄送的通用说法，直接问该不该，适合快速确认。

answers.en: Do you think I should loop in our team lead on this one?
answers.note: loop in 是办公室口语，指把人拉进沟通，比 cc 更随意。

answers.en: Would it be appropriate to copy our team lead on this email?
answers.note: 最正式，用 appropriate 征询判断，适合问上级或拿不准规矩时。

items.zh: 你邮件里那个附件是不是忘了加？
items.scene: 同事群发的周报只有正文，没看到表格

answers.en: Did you forget to attach the file to your email?
answers.note: 直接问是不是忘了，语气中性，适合关系近的同事。

answers.en: I think the attachment didn't come through — can you resend it?
answers.note: didn't come through 把问题说得像技术故障，不直接怪人，适合平级。

answers.en: It looks like the attachment is missing from your email. Could you send it again?
answers.note: It looks like 缓冲语气，比直接问忘了更委婉，适合不熟的人。

items.zh: 老板那封邮件你看了吗？什么意思啊？
items.scene: 你看到老板发了封语气很冲的全员邮件

answers.en: Did you see the boss's email? What's he even saying?
answers.note: even 带明显不满和困惑，适合在茶水间跟熟人吐槽。

answers.en: Have you read that email from the boss? What's his deal?
answers.note: What's his deal 是口语，带质疑，只对关系好的同事说。

answers.en: Did you get a chance to read the boss's email? I'm not sure what he's asking for.
answers.note: 更克制，把重点放在没看懂要求，适合不想跟着抱怨时。

items.zh: 群里那条通知你看到了吗？今天要交周报。
items.scene: 项目群刚发通知，同事还在埋头写代码

answers.en: Did you see the message in the group chat? Weekly reports are due today.
answers.note: 最中性的提醒，due today 明确截止时间，适合平级同事。

answers.en: Hey, did you catch that group message? Reports are due today.
answers.note: catch 指看到、注意到，hey 开头很随意，适合熟人。

answers.en: Have you seen the notice in the group chat? The weekly report is due today.
answers.note: notice 比 message 更像正式通知，整句稍正式，适合群里或对上级。

items.zh: 你在群里回一下呗，我都问三遍了。
items.scene: 你在项目群问物流进度，一直没人回

answers.en: Can you reply in the group? I've asked three times already.
answers.note: 直接请对方回，already 带一点无奈，适合熟同事。

answers.en: Could you chime in on the group chat? Nobody's answering me.
answers.note: chime in 指插话帮腔，语气轻松但能听出着急。

answers.en: Would you mind responding in the group? I've asked three times with no answer.
answers.note: 最客气，把事实摆出来，适合不想显得在指责时。

items.zh: 这个群我是不是该退了？天天几百条消息。
items.scene: 你被拉进无关的协调群，手机一直震

answers.en: Should I just leave this group? There are hundreds of messages a day.
answers.note: just 表示干脆退掉，先问意见，适合问关系不错的同事。

answers.en: Is it okay if I bail on this group? My phone won't stop buzzing.
answers.note: bail on 是口语退出；buzzing 画面感强，适合跟熟人吐槽。

answers.en: Do you think I can leave this group? The constant notifications are a lot.
answers.note: 更委婉，a lot 弱化抱怨，适合问上级或群主。

items.zh: 中午一起吃饭吗？楼下新开了家米线。
items.scene: 十一点半，你起身去叫隔壁工位的同事

answers.en: Want to grab lunch? A new noodle place opened downstairs.
answers.note: grab lunch 很口语，直接邀请，适合每天一起吃的饭搭子。

answers.en: You up for lunch? There's a new rice noodle spot downstairs.
answers.note: You up for 省略 Are，spot 指小店，轻松随意。

answers.en: Would you like to have lunch together? A new restaurant just opened downstairs.
answers.note: 最完整礼貌，适合刚认识或还不太熟的同事。

items.zh: 你中午又点外卖？要不跟我去食堂？
items.scene: 十二点，同事还在工位刷外卖软件

answers.en: Ordering takeout again? Why not come to the cafeteria with me?
answers.note: Why not 是轻松提议，不强迫人；takeout 是美式说法。

answers.en: Takeout again? Come to the cafeteria with me instead.
answers.note: 省略主语更随意，instead 带劝说意味，适合关系好。

answers.en: Are you getting takeout again? You could join me at the cafeteria if you want.
answers.note: 最松，if you want 不给压力，适合不想强拉人时。

items.zh: 你听说没？咱们组要换领导了。
items.scene: 午休时，你在茶水间压低声音问同事

answers.en: Did you hear? We're getting a new team lead.
answers.note: Did you hear 是八卦开场白，直接抛消息，适合熟人。

answers.en: Have you heard the news? Our team's getting a new manager.
answers.note: the news 暗示是传言，比直接说更带八卦味。

answers.en: Is it true that we're getting a new team lead? I heard it from someone in HR.
answers.note: 用 Is it true 求证并交代来源，适合跟不熟的人探口风。

items.zh: 他俩是不是在一起了？天天一起下班。
items.scene: 你注意到两个同事最近总是一起走

answers.en: Are those two together? They leave together every day.
answers.note: together 指在谈恋爱，问得直接但不失分寸，适合跟熟人聊。

answers.en: Do you think those two are dating? They clock out together every single day.
answers.note: clock out 指打卡下班，every single day 加强八卦语气。

answers.en: Is there something going on between those two? They always leave at the same time.
answers.note: something going on 是委婉打探，不把话说死，适合不想传得太难听。

items.zh: 这明明是他没交，怎么成我的问题了？
items.scene: 项目延期，组长在群里问你为什么没跟进

answers.en: He's the one who didn't submit it. How is this my problem?
answers.note: He's the one 把责任点明，How is this my problem 带委屈和火气，适合私下解释。

answers.en: That was never turned in on his end — why is it landing on me?
answers.note: on his end 指他那边；landing on me 指责任落到自己头上，带不满。

answers.en: The file was never submitted by him. I'm not sure why I'm being held responsible.
answers.note: 最克制，用被动语态讲事实，适合群里或邮件正式澄清。

items.zh: 你能不能别一出事就说是我的问题？
items.scene: 每次联调出问题，邻组同事第一句话就点名你

answers.en: Can you stop blaming me every time something goes wrong?
answers.note: 最直接，stop blaming 明确要求对方改，适合已经忍了很久。

answers.en: Why is it always my fault when something breaks?
answers.note: 反问带情绪，比直接要求更有火气，适合当面质问。

answers.en: I'd appreciate it if we could look at the issue before pointing fingers.
answers.note: pointing fingers 指甩锅指责，语气克制但立场清楚，适合有领导在场。
